p2.note: The activation diagnostic probes raw scorableEvents before boundary exclusion; the prior P2 screen scored 14 references after its boundary exclusion. Crop selections/target hashes remain identical.

interpretation.primaryFinding: The universal P2 failure is onset admission: zero of 15 reference probes has onset probability >= 0.5 within +/-2 frames, while the state head still admits the true state on 9 of 15 probes.
interpretation.secondaryFinding: PalmMute also loses state admission on both P2 references, indicating a content-specific representation/state failure in addition to onset-head collapse.
interpretation.evidence: P2 feature L2 RMS is higher than P1 for chords and singlenotes, lower for scales and PalmMute; there is no consistent global amplitude direction.
interpretation.thresholdEvidence: Reference-window onset probabilities are far below 0.5 on P2; lowering the threshold enough to rescue most references would be a post-result retune and is not scientifically justified. The P2 scale crop also has a non-reference whole-crop onset maximum above 0.5, so threshold lowering risks unrelated admissions.

decision.nextExperiment: zero-optimizer encoder-vs-onset-head decomposition on the same matched P1/P2 captures
decision.nextExperimentPurpose: Determine whether P2 divergence is already present in the shared 128-d encoder representation or is amplified primarily by the onset-head linear decision boundary.
requiredMeasurements: shared encoder activation norms/distributions at reference windows
matched P1-vs-P2 encoder cosine/euclidean distances by category/string/fret where comparable
per-string onset-head linear contribution and bias at each reference window
nearest P1 reference embedding for each P2 reference
no threshold search and no optimizer steps

subsequentDecisionRule.representationCloseButOnsetLogitCollapse: Design a tiny balanced P1+P2 onset-head-focused development fit with strict capped compute; keep shared encoder frozen initially.
subsequentDecisionRule.representationDiverged: Test normalization/representation robustness offline before any fit.
subsequentDecisionRule.PalmMuteRepresentationCollapse: Handle as content-specific representation issue; do not let an onset-head-only repair claim full generalization.
